old.desc:
**Goals for the run:**

- Acquire a hybrid weapon.
- Obtain every Claptrap SDU.
- Unlock every Steam achievement.
- Get every single unique item in the game.
- Finish every challenge log task, excluding pvp.
- Fully level up weapon proficiency of every weapon type.
- Complete all main and side missions in playthrough 1 and 2, DLCs included.

**Rules:**

- No save editor.
- Golden keys are allowed.
- Kill counter should be fulfilled.
- Trello will be used for loot following.
- For every death a challenge needs to be executed.
- Everything needs to be recorded/Streamed to have evidence.
